inferences.claim: Introly's question is the price of the next introductions: it cannot match Arjun with investors in AI tooling without the stage and size of the raise.
The stage is settled in the brief — the seed round — so only the amount is Arjun's to state.
This is the connector's own bounded ask, not an investor conversation: answering it hands Introly its matching criteria and opens no conversation with any fund.
The speed of Introly's answer marks it as an automated agent, so what matters is the content of the one line, not tone or follow-up.

frames.primary: Your own intro agent has asked one bounded question — the stage and size of the raise — and holds the next investor introductions until it is answered.
rivals: An automated nudge that would line up introductions anyway, making the answer optional.
A data-gathering step by a third-party matcher, where what Arjun shares travels beyond his control.

expected_vs_actual.expected: Without a playbook, the brief and the file set the expectation: the connector works for Arjun, so its questions get a brief answer and it lines up introductions.
expected_vs_actual.actual: Arjun told Introly what kind of investor he wants; Introly asked at once for the stage and amount, and the file holds no answer from Arjun yet.

scenarios.do_nothing: Introly's question stays open and the next introductions wait on it; the raise loses introductions you asked for.
scenarios.act: A one-line answer — the seed round and its size — lets Introly line up introductions to investors in AI tooling.
scenarios.best: Introly matches Arjun with investors in AI tooling who back seed rounds, and the introductions arrive soon after.
scenarios.worst: The question sits unanswered and the introductions stop, or Arjun states an amount he later wishes he had not.
signals_to_watch: New introductions from Introly after Arjun's answer
A further question from Introly instead of introductions
Introductions to investors outside AI tooling or outside the seed stage

reasons: Raising the seed round is the brief's first goal, and the connector's next introductions to investors wait on this answer.
